ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportSlownikiWartosci' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportSlownikiWartosci;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportSlownikiWartosci] @rowVersion bigint AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @LastMod BIGINT = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SLW_CzasModyfikacji) FROM CDN.Slowniki WHERE SLW_Kategoria IN('Rodzaje zgód dla danych osobowych','Powody wycofania zgody','Źródła zgody') AND SLW_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion),@rowVersion)
SELECT @LastMod AS [@RowVersion] ,( select * from ( select SLW_ID as [@Id], 1 as [@DirectoryId], SlW_wartoscS as [@Value], null as [@InternalName], 'true' as [@IsActive], 'false' as [@IsDefault] from cdn.Slowniki where SLW_Kategoria = 'Rodzaje zgód dla danych osobowych' AND SLW_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion
union all
select SLW_ID as [@Id], 2 as [@DirectoryId], SlW_wartoscS as [@Value], null as [@InternalName], 'true' as [@IsActive], 'false' as [@IsDefault] from cdn.Slowniki where SLW_Kategoria = 'Powody wycofania zgody' AND SLW_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion
union all
select SLW_ID as [@Id], 3 as [@DirectoryId], SlW_wartoscS as [@Value], null as [@InternalName], 'true' as [@IsActive], 'false' as [@IsDefault] from cdn.Slowniki where SLW_Kategoria = 'Źródła zgody' AND SLW_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion
/* PRZYDAŁA BY SIĘ NOWA/ODDZIELNA GAŁĄŹ W SŁOWNIKACH(JEŚLI W OGÓLE PONIŻSZE POBIERANE JEST Z WŁAŚCIWEJ GAŁĘZI) union all
select SLW_ID as [@Id], 4 as [@DirectoryId], SlW_wartoscS as [@Value], null as [@InternalName], 'true' as [@IsActive], 'false' as [@IsDefault] from cdn.Slowniki where SLW_Kategoria = 'Źródła zgody' AND SLW_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion
*/ union all
select 1 as [@Id], 1 as [@DirectoryId], 'System' as [@Value], 'System' as [@InternalName], 'true' as [@IsActive], 'true' as [@IsDefault]
union all
select slw_id as [@Id], 5 as [@DirectoryId], SLW_WartoscS as [@Value], SLW_WartoscS as [@InternalName], 'true' as [@IsActive], 'true' as [@IsDefault] from cdn.slowniki where SLW_Kategoria = 'Przyczyna korekty sprzedaż'
union all
select 2 as [@Id], 5 as [@DirectoryId], 'Skup' as [@Value], 'BuyBack' as [@InternalName], 'true' as [@IsActive], 'true' as [@IsDefault]
union all
/*select top 10000 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY kns_kntlp DESC) + 99999 as [@Id], --NIE MA WARTOŚCI W SŁOWNIKU WIĘC: tytuły osób kontaktowych od 100k - 110k 6 as [@DirectoryId], KnS_Tytul as [@Value], KnS_Tytul as [@InternalName], 'true' as [@IsActive], case when ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY kns_kntlp DESC) =1 then 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsDefault] from cdn.KntOsoby where KnS_Tytul <> ''
union all*/
select slw_id as [@Id], 7 as [@DirectoryId], SLW_WartoscS as [@Value], SLW_WartoscS as [@InternalName], 'true' as [@IsActive], 'true' as [@IsDefault] from cdn.slowniki where SLW_Kategoria = 'Stanowiska'
) a for xml path('Value'), type) for xml path('GenericDirectoryValues') SET NOCOUNT OFF;
END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportSlownikiWartosci TO CDNRaport
